027import java.lang.reflect.*;

031import org.apache.juneau.bean.swagger.Swagger;
032import org.apache.juneau.commons.*;

061/**
062 * A single session of generating a Swagger document.
063 *
064 * <h2 class='section'>See Also:</h2><ul>
065 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/JuneauBeanSwagger2">juneau-bean-swagger-v2</a>
066 * </ul>
067 */
068@SuppressWarnings({
069   "java:S112", // getSwagger(), addBodyExamples(), addRequestBeanParams() and getSchema() declare throws Exception because example generation and parsing surface arbitrary checked exceptions
070   "java:S115", // Constants use UPPER_snakeCase convention (e.g., SWAGGER_paths)
071   "java:S1168", // Swagger/OpenAPI spec: null = omit field (e.g. parseList, parseMap, nullIfEmpty, toMap, firstNonEmpty)
072   "java:S1192", // Swagger schema keys read more clearly inline than as constants.
073   "java:S3776", // getSwagger() (plus merge(Schema) and addBodyExamples()) walks every Swagger section in one pass; splitting it would obscure the document structure
074   "java:S9391", // Loops populate the mutable Swagger model in document order; stream pipelines would obscure that sequencing.
075   "resource" // Resource management handled externally
076})
077public class BasicSwaggerProviderSession {
078
079   private static final RichLogger LOG = RichLogger.getLogger(BasicSwaggerProviderSession.class);
080
081   private static Set<Integer> getCodes(List<StatusCode> la, Integer def) {
082      var codes = new TreeSet<Integer>();
083      la.stream().flatMapToInt(a -> Arrays.stream(a.value())).forEach(codes::add);
084      if (codes.isEmpty() && nn(def))
085         codes.add(def);
086      return codes;
087   }
088
089   private static MarshalledMap newMap(MarshalledMap om) {
090      if (om == null)
091         return new Json5Map();
092      return om.modifiable();
093   }
094
095   private static MarshalledList nullIfEmpty(MarshalledList l) {
096      return ie(l) ? null : l;
097   }
098
099   private static MarshalledMap nullIfEmpty(MarshalledMap m) {
100      return ie(m) ? null : m;
101   }
102
103   static String joinnl(String[]...s) {
104      for (var ss : s) {
105         if (ss.length != 0)
106            return StringUtils.joinnl(ss).trim();
107      }
108      return "";
109   }
110
111   private final RestContext context;
112   private final Class<?> c;
113   private final ClassInfo rci;
114   private final FileFinder ff;
115
116   private final Messages mb;
117
118   private final VarResolverSession vr;
119   private final JsonParser jp = Json5Parser.create().ignoreUnknownBeanProperties().build();
120
121   private final JsonSchemaGeneratorSession js;
122
123   private final Locale locale;
124
125   /**
126    * Constructor.
127    *
128    * @param context The context of the REST object we're generating Swagger about.
129    *    <br>Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
130    * @param locale The language of the swagger we're asking for.
131    * @param ff The file finder to use for finding JSON files.
132    * @param messages The messages to use for finding localized strings.
133    * @param vr The variable resolver to use for resolving variables in the swagger.
134    * @param js The JSON-schema generator to use for stuff like examples.
135    */
136   public BasicSwaggerProviderSession(RestContext context, Locale locale, FileFinder ff, Messages messages, VarResolverSession vr, JsonSchemaGeneratorSession js) {
137      this.context = context;
138      this.c = context.getResourceClass();
139      this.rci = ClassInfo.of(c);
140      this.ff = ff;
141      this.mb = messages;
142      this.vr = vr;
143      this.js = js;
144      this.locale = locale;
145   }
146
147   /**
148    * Generates the swagger.
149    *
150    * @return A new {@link Swagger} object.
151    * @throws Exception If an error occurred producing the Swagger.
152    */
153   @SuppressWarnings({
154      "java:S6541" // Single-threaded context; synchronization unnecessary
155   })
156   public Swagger getSwagger() throws Exception {
157      // @formatter:off
158
159      var is = ff.getStream(rci.getNameSimple() + ".json", locale).orElse(null);
160
161      var ap = this.context.getMarshallingContext().getAnnotationProvider();
162
163      Predicate<String> ne = Shorts::ine;
164      Predicate<Collection<?>> nec = Shorts::ine;
165      Predicate<Map<?,?>> nem = Shorts::ine;
166
167      // Load swagger JSON from classpath.
168      var omSwagger = Json5.DEFAULT.read(is, Json5Map.class);
169      if (omSwagger == null)
170         omSwagger = new Json5Map();
171
172      // Combine it with @Rest(swagger)
173      var restAnnotations = rstream(ap.find(Rest.class, rci)).map(AnnotationInfo::inner).toList();
174
175      for (var rr : restAnnotations) {
176
177         var sInfo = omSwagger.getMap("info", true);
178
179         sInfo
180            .appendIf(ne, "title",
181               firstNonEmpty(
182                  sInfo.getString("title"),
183                  resolve(rr.title())
184               )
185            )
186            .appendIf(ne, "description",
187               firstNonEmpty(
188                  sInfo.getString("description"),
189                  resolve(rr.description())
190               )
191            )
192            .appendIf(ne, "siteName",
193               firstNonEmpty(
194                  sInfo.getString("siteName"),
195                  resolve(rr.siteName())
196               )
197            );
198
199         var r = rr.swagger();
200
201         omSwagger.append(parseMap(r.value(), "@Swagger(value) on class %s", c));
202
203         if (! SwaggerAnnotation.empty(r)) {
204            var info = omSwagger.getMap("info", true);
205
206            info
207               .appendIf(ne, "title", resolve(r.title()))
208               .appendIf(ne, "description", resolve(r.description()))
209               .appendIf(ne, "version", resolve(r.version()))
210               .appendIf(ne, "termsOfService", resolve(r.termsOfService()))
211               .appendIf(nem, "contact",
212                  merge(
213                     info.getMap("contact"),
214                     toMap(r.contact())
215                  )
216               )
217               .appendIf(nem, "license",
218                  merge(
219                     info.getMap("license"),
220                     toMap(r.license())
221                  )
222               );
223         }
224
225         omSwagger
226            .appendIf(nem, "externalDocs",
227               merge(
228                  omSwagger.getMap("externalDocs"),
229                  toMap(r.externalDocs())
230               )
231            )
232            .appendIf(nec, "tags",
233               merge(
234                  omSwagger.getList("tags"),
235                  toList(r.tags())
236               )
237            );
238      }
239
240      omSwagger.appendIf(nem, "externalDocs", parseMap(mb.findFirstString("externalDocs"), "Messages/externalDocs on class %s", c));
241
242      var info = omSwagger.getMap("info", true);
243
244      info
245         .appendIf(ne, "title", resolve(mb.findFirstString("title")))
246         .appendIf(ne, "description", resolve(mb.findFirstString("description")))
247         .appendIf(ne, "version", resolve(mb.findFirstString("version")))
248         .appendIf(ne, "termsOfService", resolve(mb.findFirstString("termsOfService")))
249         .appendIf(nem, "contact", parseMap(mb.findFirstString("contact"), "Messages/contact on class %s", c))
250         .appendIf(nem, "license", parseMap(mb.findFirstString("license"), "Messages/license on class %s", c));
251
252      if (info.isEmpty())
253         omSwagger.remove("info");
254
255      var produces = omSwagger.getList("produces", true);
256      var consumes = omSwagger.getList("consumes", true);
257
258      if (consumes.isEmpty())
259         consumes.addAll(context.getConsumes());
260      if (produces.isEmpty())
261         produces.addAll(context.getProduces());
262
263      Map<String,Json5Map> tagMap = map();
264      if (omSwagger.containsKey("tags")) {
265         for (var om : omSwagger.getList("tags").elements(Json5Map.class)) {
266            String name = om.getString("name");
267            if (name == null)
268               throw new SwaggerException(null, "Tag definition found without name in swagger JSON.");
269            tagMap.put(name, om);
270         }
271      }
272
273      var s = mb.findFirstString("tags");
274      if (nn(s)) {
275         for (var m : parseListOrCdl(s, "Messages/tags on class %s", c).elements(Json5Map.class)) {
276            var name = m.getString("name");
277            if (name == null)
278               throw new SwaggerException(null, "Tag definition found without name in resource bundle on class %s", c);
279            if (tagMap.containsKey(name))
280               tagMap.get(name).putAll(m);
281            else
282               tagMap.put(name, m);
283         }
284      }
285
286      // Load our existing bean definitions into our session.
287      var definitions = omSwagger.getMap("definitions", true);
288      for (var defId : definitions.keySet())
289         js.addBeanDef(defId, new JsonMap(definitions.getMap(defId)));
290
291      // Iterate through all the @RestOp methods.
292      for (var sm : context.getRestOperations().getOpContexts()) {
293
294         var bs = sm.getMarshallingContext().getSession();
295
296         var m = sm.getJavaMethod();
297         var mi = MethodInfo.of(m);
298         var al = rstream(ap.find(mi)).filter(REST_OP_GROUP).toList();
299         var mn = m.getName();
300
301         // Honor @OpSwagger(ignore=true) — skip the operation entirely so neither the path nor the
302         // HTTP-method entry shows up in the generated spec. Done before getOperation(...) is called
303         // because that method has the side effect of inserting empty entries via computeIfAbsent.
304         var msValue = Holder.<OpSwagger>empty();
305         al.forEach(ai -> ai.getValue(OpSwagger.class, "swagger").filter(OpSwaggerAnnotation::notEmpty).ifPresent(msValue::set));
306         var ms = msValue.orElseGet(() -> OpSwaggerAnnotation.create().build());
307         if (ms.ignore())
308            continue;
309
310         // Get the operation from the existing swagger so far.
311         var op = getOperation(omSwagger, sm.getPathPattern(), lcr(sm.getHttpMethod()));
312
313         op.append(parseMap(ms.value(), "@OpSwagger(value) on class %s method %s", c, m));
314         op.appendIf(ne, "operationId",
315            firstNonEmpty(
316               resolve(ms.operationId()),
317               op.getString("operationId"),
318               mn
319            )
320         );
321
322      var summaryValue = Holder.<String>empty();
323      al.forEach(ai -> ai.getValue(String.class, "summary").filter(NOT_EMPTY).ifPresent(summaryValue::set));
324      op.appendIf(ne, "summary",
325         firstNonEmpty(
326            resolve(ms.summary()),
327            resolve(mb.findFirstString(mn + ".summary")),
328            op.getString("summary"),
329            resolve(summaryValue.orElse(null))
330         )
331      );
332
333      var descriptionValue = Holder.<String[]>empty();
334      al.forEach(ai -> ai.getValue(String[].class, "description").filter(x -> x.length > 0).ifPresent(descriptionValue::set));
335      op.appendIf(ne, "description",
336         firstNonEmpty(
337            resolve(ms.description()),
338            resolve(mb.findFirstString(mn + ".description")),
339            op.getString("description"),
340            resolve(descriptionValue.orElse(new String[0]))
341         )
342      );
343         op.appendIf(ne, "deprecated",
344            firstNonEmpty(
345               resolve(ms.deprecated()),
346               (nn(m.getAnnotation(Deprecated.class)) || nn(ClassInfo.of(m.getDeclaringClass()).getAnnotations(Deprecated.class).findFirst().map(AnnotationInfo::inner).orElse(null))) ? "true" : null
347            )
348         );
349         op.appendIf(nec, "tags",
350            merge(
351               parseListOrCdl(mb.findFirstString(mn + ".tags"), "Messages/tags on class %s method %s", c, m),
352               parseListOrCdl(ms.tags(), "@OpSwagger(tags) on class %s method %s", c, m)
353            )
354         );
355         op.appendIf(nec, "schemes",
356            merge(
357               parseListOrCdl(mb.findFirstString(mn + ".schemes"), "Messages/schemes on class %s method %s", c, m),
358               parseListOrCdl(ms.schemes(), "@OpSwagger(schemes) on class %s method %s", c, m)
359            )
360         );
361         op.appendIf(nec, "consumes",
362            firstNonEmpty(
363               parseListOrCdl(mb.findFirstString(mn + ".consumes"), "Messages/consumes on class %s method %s", c, m),
364               parseListOrCdl(ms.consumes(), "@OpSwagger(consumes) on class %s method %s", c, m)
365            )
366         );
367         op.appendIf(nec, "produces",
368            firstNonEmpty(
369               parseListOrCdl(mb.findFirstString(mn + ".produces"), "Messages/produces on class %s method %s", c, m),
370               parseListOrCdl(ms.produces(), "@OpSwagger(produces) on class %s method %s", c, m)
371            )
372         );
373         op.appendIf(nec, "parameters",
374            merge(
375               parseList(mb.findFirstString(mn + ".parameters"), "Messages/parameters on class %s method %s", c, m),
376               parseList(ms.parameters(), "@OpSwagger(parameters) on class %s method %s", c, m)
377            )
378         );
379         op.appendIf(nem, "responses",
380            merge(
381               parseMap(mb.findFirstString(mn + ".responses"), "Messages/responses on class %s method %s", c, m),
382               parseMap(ms.responses(), "@OpSwagger(responses) on class %s method %s", c, m)
383            )
384         );
385         op.appendIf(nem, "externalDocs",
386            merge(
387               op.getMap("externalDocs"),
388               parseMap(mb.findFirstString(mn + ".externalDocs"), "Messages/externalDocs on class %s method %s", c, m),
389               toMap(ms.externalDocs())
390            )
391         );
392
393         if (op.containsKey("tags"))
394            for (var tag : op.getList("tags").elements(String.class))
395               if (! tagMap.containsKey(tag))
396                  tagMap.put(tag, Json5Map.of("name", tag));
397
398         var paramMap = new Json5Map();
399         if (op.containsKey("parameters"))
400            for (var param : op.getList("parameters").elements(Json5Map.class))
401               paramMap.put(param.getString("in") + '.' + (eq(param.getString("in"), "body") ? "body" : param.getString("name")), param);
402
403         // Finally, look for parameters defined on method.
404         for (var mpi : mi.getParameters()) {
405
406            var pt = mpi.getParameterType();
407            var type = pt.innerType();
408
409            if (ap.has(Content.class, mpi)) {
410               var param = paramMap.getMap(BODY + ".body", true).append("in", BODY);
411               var schema = getSchema(param.getMap("schema"), type, bs);
412               rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, mpi)).forEach(x -> merge(schema, x.inner()));
413               rstream(ap.find(Content.class, mpi)).forEach(x -> merge(schema, x.inner().schema()));
414               pushupSchemaFields(BODY, param, schema);
415               param.appendIf(nem, "schema", schema);
416               param.putIfAbsent("required", "true");
417               addBodyExamples(sm, param, false, type, locale);
418
419            } else if (ap.has(Query.class, mpi)) {
420               var name = findAnnotationName(ap, Query.class, mpi).orElse(null);
421               var param = paramMap.getMap(QUERY + "." + name, true).append("name", name).append("in", QUERY);
422               rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, mpi)).forEach(x -> merge(param, x.inner()));
423               rstream(ap.find(Query.class, mpi)).forEach(x -> merge(param, x.inner().schema()));
424               pushupSchemaFields(QUERY, param, getSchema(param.getMap("schema"), type, bs));
425               addParamExample(sm, param, QUERY);
426
427            } else if (ap.has(FormData.class, mpi)) {
428               var name = findAnnotationName(ap, FormData.class, mpi).orElse(null);
429               var param = paramMap.getMap(FORM_DATA + "." + name, true).append("name", name).append("in", FORM_DATA);
430               rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, mpi)).forEach(x -> merge(param, x.inner()));
431               rstream(ap.find(FormData.class, mpi)).forEach(x -> merge(param, x.inner().schema()));
432               pushupSchemaFields(FORM_DATA, param, getSchema(param.getMap("schema"), type, bs));
433               addParamExample(sm, param, FORM_DATA);
434
435            } else if (ap.has(Header.class, mpi)) {
436               var name = findAnnotationName(ap, Header.class, mpi).orElse(null);
437               var param = paramMap.getMap(HEADER + "." + name, true).append("name", name).append("in", HEADER);
438               rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, mpi)).forEach(x -> merge(param, x.inner()));
439               rstream(ap.find(Header.class, mpi)).forEach(x -> merge(param, x.inner().schema()));
440               pushupSchemaFields(HEADER, param, getSchema(param.getMap("schema"), type, bs));
441               addParamExample(sm, param, HEADER);
442
443            } else if (ap.has(Path.class, mpi)) {
444               var name = findAnnotationName(ap, Path.class, mpi).orElse(null);
445               var param = paramMap.getMap(PATH + "." + name, true).append("name", name).append("in", PATH);
446               rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, mpi)).forEach(x -> merge(param, x.inner()));
447               rstream(ap.find(Path.class, mpi)).forEach(x -> merge(param, x.inner().schema()));
448               pushupSchemaFields(PATH, param, getSchema(param.getMap("schema"), type, bs));
449               addParamExample(sm, param, PATH);
450               param.putIfAbsent("required", "true");
451
452            } else if (ap.has(Request.class, mpi)) {
453               addRequestBeanParams(ap, sm, paramMap, mpi, bs);
454            }
455         }
456
457         if (! paramMap.isEmpty())
458            op.put("parameters", paramMap.values());
459
460         var responses = op.getMap("responses", true);
461
462         for (var eci : mi.getExceptionTypes()) {
463            if (eci.hasAnnotation(Response.class)) {
464               var la = rstream(ap.find(Response.class, eci)).map(AnnotationInfo::inner).toList();
465               var la2 = rstream(ap.find(StatusCode.class, eci)).map(x -> x.inner()).toList();
466               var codes = getCodes(la2, 500);
467               for (var a : la) {
468                  for (var code : codes) {
469                     var om = responses.getMap(String.valueOf(code), true);
470                     merge(om, a);
471                     var schema = getSchema(om.getMap("schema"), m.getGenericReturnType(), bs);
472                     rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, eci)).forEach(x -> merge(schema, x.inner()));
473                     pushupSchemaFields(RESPONSE, om, schema);
474                     om.appendIf(nem, "schema", schema);
475               }
476            }
477            var methods = eci.getAllMethods();
478            for (var i = methods.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
479               var ecmi = methods.get(i);
480               var a = ecmi.getAnnotations(Header.class).findFirst().map(AnnotationInfo::inner).orElse(null);
481                  if (a == null)
482                     a = ecmi.getReturnType().unwrap(Holder.class, Optional.class).getAnnotations(Header.class).findFirst().map(AnnotationInfo::inner).orElse(null);
483                  if (nn(a) && ! isMulti(a)) {
484                     var ha = a.name();
485                     for (var code : codes) {
486                        var header = responses.getMap(String.valueOf(code), true).getMap("headers", true).getMap(ha, true);
487                        rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, ecmi)).forEach(x -> merge(header, x.inner()));
488                        rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, ecmi.getReturnType().unwrap(Holder.class, Optional.class))).forEach(x -> merge(header, x.inner()));
489                        pushupSchemaFields(RESPONSE_HEADER, header, getSchema(header.getMap("schema"), ecmi.getReturnType().unwrap(Holder.class, Optional.class).innerType(), bs));
490                     }
491                  }
492               }
493            }
494         }
495
496         if (mi.hasAnnotation(Response.class) || mi.getReturnType().unwrap(Holder.class, Optional.class).hasAnnotation(Response.class)) {
497            var la = rstream(ap.find(Response.class, mi)).map(x -> x.inner()).toList();
498            var la2 = rstream(ap.find(StatusCode.class, mi)).map(x -> x.inner()).toList();
499            var codes = getCodes(la2, 200);
500            for (var a : la) {
501               for (var code : codes) {
502                  var om = responses.getMap(String.valueOf(code), true);
503                  merge(om, a);
504                  var schema = getSchema(om.getMap("schema"), m.getGenericReturnType(), bs);
505                  rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, mi)).forEach(x -> merge(schema, x.inner()));
506                  pushupSchemaFields(RESPONSE, om, schema);
507                  om.appendIf(nem, "schema", schema);
508                  addBodyExamples(sm, om, true, m.getGenericReturnType(), locale);
509               }
510         }
511         if (mi.getReturnType().hasAnnotation(Response.class)) {
512            var methods = mi.getReturnType().getAllMethods();
513            for (var i = methods.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
514               var ecmi = methods.get(i);
515                  if (ecmi.hasAnnotation(Header.class)) {
516                     var a = ecmi.getAnnotations(Header.class).findFirst().map(AnnotationInfo::inner).orElse(null);
517                     var ha = a.name();
518                     if (! isMulti(a)) {
519                        for (var code : codes) {
520                           var header = responses.getMap(String.valueOf(code), true).getMap("headers", true).getMap(ha, true);
521                           rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, ecmi)).forEach(x -> merge(header, x.inner()));
522                           rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, ecmi.getReturnType().unwrap(Holder.class, Optional.class))).forEach(x -> merge(header, x.inner()));
523                           merge(header, a.schema());
524                           pushupSchemaFields(RESPONSE_HEADER, header, getSchema(header, ecmi.getReturnType().innerType(), bs));
525                        }
526                     }
527                  }
528               }
529            }
530         } else if (m.getGenericReturnType() != void.class) {
531            var om = responses.getMap("200", true);
532            var pt2 = ClassInfo.of(m.getGenericReturnType());
533            var schema = getSchema(om.getMap("schema"), m.getGenericReturnType(), bs);
534            rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, pt2)).forEach(x -> merge(schema, x.inner()));
535            pushupSchemaFields(RESPONSE, om, schema);
536            om.appendIf(nem, "schema", schema);
537            addBodyExamples(sm, om, true, m.getGenericReturnType(), locale);
538         }
539
540         // Finally, look for Value @Header parameters defined on method.
541         for (var mpi : mi.getParameters()) {
542
543            var pt = mpi.getParameterType();
544
545            if (pt.is(Holder.class) && (ap.has(Header.class, mpi))) {
546               var la = rstream(ap.find(Header.class, mpi)).map(AnnotationInfo::inner).toList();
547               var la2 = rstream(ap.find(StatusCode.class, mpi)).map(AnnotationInfo::inner).toList();
548               var codes = getCodes(la2, 200);
549               var name = findAnnotationName(ap, Header.class, mpi).orElse(null);
550               var type = Holder.unwrap(mpi.getParameterType().innerType());
551               for (var a : la) {
552                  if (! isMulti(a)) {
553                     for (var code : codes) {
554                        var header = responses.getMap(String.valueOf(code), true).getMap("headers", true).getMap(name, true);
555                        rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, mpi)).forEach(x -> merge(header, x.inner()));
556                        merge(header, a.schema());
557                        pushupSchemaFields(RESPONSE_HEADER, header, getSchema(header, type, bs));
558                     }
559                  }
560               }
561
562            } else if (ap.has(Response.class, mpi)) {
563               var la = rstream(ap.find(Response.class, mpi)).map(AnnotationInfo::inner).toList();
564               var la2 = rstream(ap.find(StatusCode.class, mpi)).map(AnnotationInfo::inner).toList();
565               var codes = getCodes(la2, 200);
566               var type = Holder.unwrap(mpi.getParameterType().innerType());
567               for (var a : la) {
568                  for (var code : codes) {
569                     var om = responses.getMap(String.valueOf(code), true);
570                     merge(om, a);
571                     var schema = getSchema(om.getMap("schema"), type, bs);
572                     rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, mpi)).forEach(x -> merge(schema, x.inner()));
573                     la.forEach(x -> merge(schema, x.schema()));
574                     pushupSchemaFields(RESPONSE, om, schema);
575                     om.appendIf(nem, "schema", schema);
576                  }
577               }
578            }
579         }
580
581         // Add default response descriptions.
582         for (var e : responses.entrySet()) {
583            var key = e.getKey();
584            var val = responses.getMap(key);
585            if (isDecimal(key))
586               val.appendIfAbsentIf(ne, "description", RestUtils.getHttpResponseText(Integer.parseInt(key)));
587         }
588
589         if (responses.isEmpty())
590            op.remove("responses");
591         else
592            op.put("responses", new TreeMap<>(responses));
593
594         if (! op.containsKey("consumes")) {
595            var mConsumes = sm.getSupportedContentTypes();
596            if (! mConsumes.equals(consumes))
597               op.put("consumes", mConsumes);
598         }
599
600         if (! op.containsKey("produces")) {
601            var mProduces = sm.getSupportedAcceptTypes();
602            if (! mProduces.equals(produces))
603               op.put("produces", mProduces);
604         }
605      }
606
607      if (nn(js.getBeanDefs()))
608         for (var e : js.getBeanDefs().entrySet())
609            definitions.put(e.getKey(), fixSwaggerExtensions(renameWriteOnly(e.getValue())));
610
611      if (definitions.isEmpty())
612         omSwagger.remove("definitions");
613
614      if (! tagMap.isEmpty())
615         omSwagger.put("tags", tagMap.values());
616
617      if (consumes.isEmpty())
618         omSwagger.remove("consumes");
619      if (produces.isEmpty())
620         omSwagger.remove("produces");
621
622      try {
623         var swaggerJson = Json5R.of(omSwagger);
624         return jp.read(swaggerJson, Swagger.class);
625      } catch (Exception e) {
626         throw new ServletException("Error detected in swagger.", e);
627      }
628      // @formatter:on
629   }

631   private void addBodyExamples(RestOpContext sm, MarshalledMap piri, boolean response, Type type, Locale locale) throws Exception {
632
633      var sex = piri.getString("example");
634
635      if (sex == null) {
636         var schema = resolveRef(piri.getMap("schema"));
637         if (nn(schema))
638            sex = schema.getString("example", schema.getString("example"));
639      }
640
641      if (isEmpty(sex))
642         return;
643
644      Object example = null;
645      if (isProbablyJson(sex)) {
646         example = jp.read(sex, type);
647      } else {
648         var cm = js.getClassMeta(type);
649         if (cm.hasStringMutater()) {
650            example = cm.basicConverter().to(sex, cm.inner());
651         }
652      }
653
654      var examplesKey = "examples";  // Parameters don't have an examples attribute.
655
656      var examples = piri.getMap(examplesKey);
657      if (examples == null)
658         examples = new Json5Map();
659
660      var mediaTypes = response ? sm.getSerializers().getSupportedMediaTypes() : sm.getParsers().getSupportedMediaTypes();
661
662      for (var mt : mediaTypes) {
663         if (mt != MediaType.HTML) {
664            var s2 = sm.getSerializers().getSerializer(mt).orElse(null);
665            if (nn(s2)) {
666               try {
667                  // @formatter:off
668                  var eVal = s2
669                     .createSession()
670                     .locale(locale)
671                     .mediaType(mt)
672                     .apply(WriterSerializerSession.Builder.class, x -> x.useWhitespace(true))
673                     .build()
674                     .writeToString(example);
675                  // @formatter:on
676                  examples.put(s2.getPrimaryMediaType().toString(), eVal);
677               } catch (Exception e) {
678                  LOG.fine("Could not serialize to media type [%s]: %s", mt, localizedMessage(e));
679               }
680            }
681         }
682      }
683
684      if (! examples.isEmpty())
685         piri.put(examplesKey, examples);
686   }

688   @SuppressWarnings({
689      "java:S1172", // Parameter kept to match interface contract
690      "unused" // Eclipse: type parameter unused but kept for API consistency
691   })
692   /**
693    * Documents each annotated getter of a {@link Request @Request} bean parameter as its own part parameter, merging
694    * the getter's {@link Schema @Schema} and part-annotation {@code schema} the same way as for a plain part argument.
695    *
696    * <p>
697    * {@link Content @Content} getters are skipped: a request bean's body is documented by the bean's own schema, not
698    * by a part parameter.
699    */
700   private void addRequestBeanParams(AnnotationProvider ap, RestOpContext sm, Json5Map paramMap, ParameterInfo mpi, MarshallingSession bs) throws Exception {
701      var rbm = RequestBeanMeta.create(mpi, AnnotationWorkList.create());
702      if (rbm == null)
703         return;
704      for (var pm : rbm.getProperties()) {
705         var mi = MethodInfo.of(pm.getGetter());
706         var type = pm.getGetter().getGenericReturnType();
707         var schemas = new ArrayList<Schema>();
708         rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, mi)).forEach(x -> schemas.add(x.inner()));
709         RestPartType in;
710         switch (pm.getPartType()) {
711            case QUERY -> {
712               in = QUERY;
713               rstream(ap.find(Query.class, mi)).forEach(x -> schemas.add(x.inner().schema()));
714            }
715            case FORMDATA -> {
716               in = FORM_DATA;
717               rstream(ap.find(FormData.class, mi)).forEach(x -> schemas.add(x.inner().schema()));
718            }
719            case HEADER -> {
720               in = HEADER;
721               rstream(ap.find(Header.class, mi)).forEach(x -> schemas.add(x.inner().schema()));
722            }
723            case PATH -> {
724               in = PATH;
725               rstream(ap.find(Path.class, mi)).forEach(x -> schemas.add(x.inner().schema()));
726            }
727            default -> {
728               continue;
729            }
730         }
731         var name = pm.getPartName();
732         var param = paramMap.getMap(in + "." + name, true).append("name", name).append("in", in);
733         schemas.forEach(x -> merge(param, x));
734         pushupSchemaFields(in, param, getSchema(param.getMap("schema"), type, bs));
735         addParamExample(sm, param, in);
736         if (in == PATH)
737            param.putIfAbsent("required", "true");
738      }
739   }
740
741   private static void addParamExample(RestOpContext sm, MarshalledMap piri, RestPartType in) {
742
743      var s = piri.getString("example");
744
745      if (isEmpty(s))
746         return;
747
748      var examples = piri.getMap("examples");
749      if (examples == null)
750         examples = new Json5Map();
751
752      var paramName = piri.getString("name");
753
754      if (in == QUERY)
755         s = "?" + urlEncodeLax(paramName) + "=" + urlEncodeLax(s);
756      else if (in == FORM_DATA)
757         s = paramName + "=" + s;
758      else if (in == HEADER)
759         s = paramName + ": " + s;
760      else if (in == PATH)
761         s = sm.getPathPattern().replace("{" + paramName + "}", urlEncodeLax(s));
762
763      examples.put("example", s);
764
765      if (! examples.isEmpty())
766         piri.put("examples", examples);
767   }

780   private static MarshalledMap fixSwaggerExtensions(MarshalledMap om) {
781      Predicate<Object> nn = Shorts::nn;
782      // @formatter:off
783      om
784         .appendIf(nn, "discriminator", om.remove("x-discriminator"))
785         .appendIf(nn, "readOnly", om.remove("x-readOnly"))
786         .appendIf(nn, "xml", om.remove("x-xml"))
787         .appendIf(nn, "externalDocs", om.remove("x-externalDocs"))
788         .appendIf(nn, "example", om.remove("x-example"));
789      // @formatter:on
790      return nullIfEmpty(om);
791   }

800   private MarshalledMap getSchema(MarshalledMap schema, Type type, MarshallingSession bs) throws Exception {
801
802      if (type == Swagger.class)
803         return Json5Map.create();
804
805      schema = newMap(schema);
806
807      var cm = bs.getClassMeta(type);
808
809      if (schema.is("ignore", false))
810         return null;
811
812      if (schema.containsKey("type") || schema.containsKey("$ref"))
813         return schema;
814
815      return fixSwaggerExtensions(schema.append(renameWriteOnly(js.getSchema(cm))));
816   }

818   /**
819    * Swagger 2.0 has no <js>"writeOnly"</js> schema keyword, so rename the generator's flag to the <js>"x-writeOnly"</js> extension.
820    *
821    * <p>
822    * Only walks schema-keyword positions (so example/default values are untouched).  The OpenAPI 3.x provider maps the
823    * extension back to the native keyword.
824    */
825   // HTT: package-private only so a unit test can check that example/default values are not walked.
826   static <T> T renameWriteOnly(T schema) {
827      if (schema instanceof Map<?,?> m) {
828         @SuppressWarnings({
829            "unchecked" // The instanceof Map<?,?> match is a JSON-model map, whose keys are strings.
830         })
831         var m2 = (Map<String,Object>)m;
832         if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(m2.get("writeOnly"))) {
833            m2.remove("writeOnly");
834            m2.put("x-writeOnly", true);
835         }
836         for (var k : new String[]{"properties", "patternProperties", "definitions", "$defs"}) {
837            if (m2.get(k) instanceof Map<?,?> children)
838               children.values().forEach(BasicSwaggerProviderSession::renameWriteOnly);
839         }
840         for (var k : new String[]{"items", "additionalProperties", "not"})
841            renameWriteOnly(m2.get(k));
842         for (var k : new String[]{"allOf", "anyOf", "oneOf", "items"}) {
843            if (m2.get(k) instanceof List<?> l)
844               l.forEach(BasicSwaggerProviderSession::renameWriteOnly);
845         }
846      }
847      return schema;
848   }

930         .appendIf(nf, "uniqueItems", a.uniqueItems() || a.ui())

1033   private MarshalledList parseList(Object o, String location, Object...locationArgs) throws ParseException {
1034      try {
1035         if (o == null)
1036            return null;
1037         var s = (o instanceof String[] o2 ? joinnl(o2) : o.toString());
1038         if (s.isEmpty())
1039            return null;
1040         s = resolve(s);
1041         if (! isProbablyJsonArray(s, true))
1042            s = "[" + s + "]";
1043         return Json5List.ofString(s);
1044      } catch (ParseException e) {
1045         throw new SwaggerException(e, "Malformed swagger JSON array encountered in " + location + ".", locationArgs);
1046      }
1047   }

1063   private MarshalledMap parseMap(Object o) throws ParseException {
1064      if (o == null)
1065         return null;
1066      if (o instanceof String[] o2)
1067         o = joinnl(o2);
1068      if (o instanceof String o2) {
1069         if (o2.isEmpty())
1070            return null;
1071         o2 = resolve(o2);
1072         if (eqic("IGNORE", o2))
1073            return Json5Map.of("ignore", true);
1074         if (! isProbablyJsonObject(o2, true))
1075            o2 = "{" + o2 + "}";
1076         return Json5Map.ofString(o2);
1077      }
1078      if (o instanceof Json5Map o2)
1079         return o2;
1080      if (o instanceof MarshalledMap o2)
1081         return new Json5Map(o2);
1082      throw new SwaggerException(null, "Unexpected data type '%s'.  Expected Map or String.", cn(o));
1083   }

1103   private static MarshalledMap pushupSchemaFields(RestPartType type, MarshalledMap param, MarshalledMap schema) {
1104      // @formatter:off
1105      Predicate<Object> ne = Shorts::ine;
1106      if (nn(schema) && ! schema.isEmpty()) {
1107         if (type == BODY || type == RESPONSE) {
1108            param
1109               .appendIf(ne, "description", schema.remove("description"));
1110         } else {
1111            param
1112               .appendIfAbsentIf(ne, "collectionFormat", schema.remove("collectionFormat"))
1113               .appendIfAbsentIf(ne, "default", schema.remove("default"))
1114               .appendIfAbsentIf(ne, "description", schema.remove("description"))
1115               .appendIfAbsentIf(ne, "enum", schema.remove("enum"))
1116               .appendIfAbsentIf(ne, "example", schema.remove("example"))
1117               .appendIfAbsentIf(ne, "exclusiveMaximum", schema.remove("exclusiveMaximum"))

1263   private static Optional<String> findAnnotationName(AnnotationProvider ap, Class<? extends java.lang.annotation.Annotation> type, ParameterInfo pi) {
